name: 07-leading-fragment-merged-forward
covers: A short FIRST fragment has no previous step, so it merges FORWARD
why: C4.2 2d says 'into the previous step' and does not say what happens when there is none. A frozen file cannot have an open question, so the direction is pinned here: forward, because it is the only one available and the rule's purpose is to eliminate the one-word step either way.

calls.reasoning:
Hmm.
The algae patch doubles every day and covers the whole pond on day forty-eight, so working backwards is the sound approach here.
So half the pond on day forty-seven and a quarter on day forty-six.
